judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: A green 'Saiba mais' button link (aria-label 'Saiba mais', no title, no aria-describedby) at the bottom of the course card for Enfermagem, linking to /cursos/graduacao/bacharelado-em-enfermagem/presencial/. In the snapshot the card is an article; inside it, before the link in document order, is an h3 card title 'Enfermagem' (itself a link to the same address, as is the image link 'Ver detalhes do curso: Enfermagem'). That h3 is the heading just before the link, which this round counts as context (H80), so 'Saiba mais' together with it tells users the link gives more about that course: the claim that nothing around it tells where it goes is false of the capture (claimTrue no), and the link meets 2.4.4 (elementFails no). The other 'Saiba mais' links on the page sit under different card headings, so they are not one set under R1. The screenshot is fully styled and shows the course title above the button; the live server HTML fetched today has the same markup, the same aria-label and href, and the h3 before the link, so the capture does not differ in a way that matters (captureDiffers no). The checker had the preceding headings and still judged the link ambiguous, so this is a false positive from model error.
